label: Late-sequence prose skeleton
explanation: It fires only after substantial context has built up — never in the first ~15 tokens of a sequence, with probability and strength rising toward position 127 — landing on frequent grammatical tokens (commas, periods, "of", "that", "to", "and", and main verbs) that form the connective backbone of multi-clause prose; no single token reliably triggers it (all conditional rates ≤1%). The strongest activations are sustained cascades across consecutive tokens in flowing narrative passages, while it stays silent at sequence starts and on rare content words like proper nouns.
